license_note: The Qwen team's announcement states the Qwen3 Embedding series is open-sourced under Apache 2.0, and the Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B repository carries an Apache License, Version 2.0 LICENSE file and declares license apache-2.0. No separate model-use terms were found on the pages read.

license_evidence.scope: Qwen3-Embedding-8B weights published in Alibaba's Qwen Hugging Face repository

access_boundary: This record represents the Qwen3-Embedding-8B checkpoint. The 0.6B and 4B siblings, the Qwen3-Reranker line, the Qwen3 language models the series is built on, and ModelScope mirror pages are separate boundaries.
strengths: Apache 2.0 grant stated in the release announcement and carried in a LICENSE file inside the weight repository
Top-ranked multilingual retrieval at release with flexible vector dimensions and user-defined instructions in an 8B checkpoint
tradeoffs: No developer API or managed host serves this checkpoint, so running it is entirely self-operated
The 8B checkpoint needs accelerator-class hardware where the 0.6B sibling runs leaner, so sizing is workload-dependent
